## Component documentation for: Animated Image

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-animated-image>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: A component for displaying animated GIFs and WEBPs that play and pause on interaction.

### API Documentation for `<wa-animated-image>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: play-icon
Slot Description: Optional play icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

Slot Name: pause-icon
Slot Description: Optional pause icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: src
HTML Attribute: src
Description: The path to the image to load.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: alt
HTML Attribute: alt
Description: A description of the image used by assistive devices.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: play
HTML Attribute: play
Description: Plays the animation. When this attribute is remove, the animation will pause.
Expected Type: boolean
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-load
Event Description: Emitted when the image loads successfully.

Event Name: wa-error
Event Description: Emitted when the image fails to load.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--control-box-size)
CSS Property Description The size of the icon box.

CSS Property: var(--icon-size)
CSS Property Description The size of the play/pause icons.

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-animated-image>`

`<wa-icon>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-animated-image>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/animated-image/animated-image.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/animated-image/animated-image.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaAnimatedImage from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/animated-image/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Animation

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-animation>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Animate elements declaratively with nearly 100 baked-in presets, or roll your own with custom keyframes. Powered by the [Web Animations API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Animations_API).

### API Documentation for `<wa-animation>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The element to animate. Avoid slotting in more than one element, as subsequent ones will be ignored. To animate multiple elements, either wrap them in a single container or use multiple `<wa-animation>` elements.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: name
HTML Attribute: name
Description: The name of the built-in animation to use. For custom animations, use the `keyframes` prop.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: 'none'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: play
HTML Attribute: play
Description: Plays the animation. When omitted, the animation will be paused. This attribute will be automatically removed when
the animation finishes or gets canceled.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: delay
HTML Attribute: delay
Description: The number of milliseconds to delay the start of the animation.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: direction
HTML Attribute: direction
Description: Determines the direction of playback as well as the behavior when reaching the end of an iteration.
[Learn more](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-direction)
Expected Type: PlaybackDirection
Default Property Value: 'normal'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: duration
HTML Attribute: duration
Description: The number of milliseconds each iteration of the animation takes to complete.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1000
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: easing
HTML Attribute: easing
Description: The easing function to use for the animation. This can be a Web Awesome easing function or a custom easing function
such as `cubic-bezier(0, 1, .76, 1.14)`.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: 'linear'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: endDelay
HTML Attribute: end-delay
Description: The number of milliseconds to delay after the active period of an animation sequence.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: fill
HTML Attribute: fill
Description: Sets how the animation applies styles to its target before and after its execution.
Expected Type: FillMode
Default Property Value: 'auto'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: iterations
HTML Attribute: iterations
Description: The number of iterations to run before the animation completes. Defaults to `Infinity`, which loops.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: Infinity
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: iterationStart
HTML Attribute: iteration-start
Description: The offset at which to start the animation, usually between 0 (start) and 1 (end).
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: keyframes
Description: The keyframes to use for the animation. If this is set, `name` will be ignored.
Expected Type: Keyframe[] | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: playbackRate
HTML Attribute: playback-rate
Description: Sets the animation's playback rate. The default is `1`, which plays the animation at a normal speed. Setting this
to `2`, for example, will double the animation's speed. A negative value can be used to reverse the animation. This
value can be changed without causing the animation to restart.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: currentTime
Description: Gets and sets the current animation time.
Expected Type: CSSNumberish
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-cancel
Event Description: Emitted when the animation is canceled.

Event Name: wa-finish
Event Description: Emitted when the animation finishes.

Event Name: wa-start
Event Description: Emitted when the animation starts or restarts.

#### CSS Custom Properties





#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-animation>`



#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-animation>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/animation/animation.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/animation/animation.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaAnimation from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/animation/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Avatar

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-avatar>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Avatars are used to represent a person or object.

### API Documentation for `<wa-avatar>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: icon
Slot Description: The default icon to use when no image or initials are present. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: image
HTML Attribute: image
Description: The image source to use for the avatar.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: A label to use to describe the avatar to assistive devices.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: initials
HTML Attribute: initials
Description: Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available (1-2 characters max recommended).
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: loading
HTML Attribute: loading
Description: Indicates how the browser should load the image.
Expected Type: 'eager' | 'lazy'
Default Property Value: 'eager'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: shape
HTML Attribute: shape
Description: The shape of the avatar.
Expected Type: 'circle' | 'square' | 'rounded'
Default Property Value: 'circle'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-error
Event Description: The image could not be loaded. This may because of an invalid URL, a temporary network condition, or some unknown cause.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--size)
CSS Property Description The size of the avatar.

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-avatar>`

`<wa-icon>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-avatar>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/avatar/avatar.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/avatar/avatar.js';`

Description: The label to use for the breadcrumb control. This will not be shown on the screen, but it will be announced by
screen readers and other assistive devices to provide more context for users.

Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

## Component documentation for: Breadcrumb Item

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-breadcrumb-item>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Breadcrumb Items are used inside breadcrumbs to represent different links.

### API Documentation for `<wa-breadcrumb-item>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The breadcrumb item's label.

Slot Name: start
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed before the label.

Slot Name: end
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed after the label.

Slot Name: separator
Slot Description: The separator to use for the breadcrumb item. This will only change the separator for this item. If you want to change it for all items in the group, set the separator on `<wa-breadcrumb>` instead.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: href
HTML Attribute: href
Description: Optional URL to direct the user to when the breadcrumb item is activated. When set, a link will be rendered
internally. When unset, a button will be rendered instead.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: target
HTML Attribute: target
Description: Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is set.
Expected Type: '_blank' | '_parent' | '_self' | '_top' | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: rel
HTML Attribute: rel
Description: The `rel` attribute to use on the link. Only used when `href` is set.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: 'noreferrer noopener'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events





#### CSS Custom Properties





#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-breadcrumb-item>`



#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-breadcrumb-item>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/breadcrumb-item/breadcrumb-item.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/breadcrumb-item/breadcrumb-item.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaBreadcrumbItem from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/breadcrumb-item/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Button

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-button>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Buttons represent actions that are available to the user.

### API Documentation for `<wa-button>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The button's label.

Slot Name: start
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed before the label.

Slot Name: end
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed after the label.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: variant
HTML Attribute: variant
Description: The button's theme variant. Defaults to `neutral` if not within another element with a variant.
Expected Type: 'neutral' | 'brand' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'
Default Property Value: 'neutral'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: appearance
HTML Attribute: appearance
Description: The button's visual appearance.
Expected Type: 'accent' | 'filled' | 'outlined' | 'plain'
Default Property Value: 'accent'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: size
HTML Attribute: size
Description: The button's size.
Expected Type: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
Default Property Value: 'medium'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: withCaret
HTML Attribute: with-caret
Description: Draws the button with a caret. Used to indicate that the button triggers a dropdown menu or similar behavior.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: disabled
HTML Attribute: disabled
Description: Disables the button. Does not apply to link buttons.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: loading
HTML Attribute: loading
Description: Draws the button in a loading state.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: pill
HTML Attribute: pill
Description: Draws a pill-style button with rounded edges.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: type
HTML Attribute: type
Description: The type of button. Note that the default value is `button` instead of `submit`, which is opposite of how native
`<button>` elements behave. When the type is `submit`, the button will submit the surrounding form.
Expected Type: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
Default Property Value: 'button'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: name
HTML Attribute: name
Description: The name of the button, submitted as a name/value pair with form data, but only when this button is the submitter.
This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: value
HTML Attribute: value
Description: The value of the button, submitted as a pair with the button's name as part of the form data, but only when this
button is the submitter. This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: href
HTML Attribute: href
Description: When set, the underlying button will be rendered as an `<a>` with this `href` instead of a `<button>`.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: target
HTML Attribute: target
Description: Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is present.
Expected Type: '_blank' | '_parent' | '_self' | '_top'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: rel
HTML Attribute: rel
Description: When using `href`, this attribute will map to the underlying link's `rel` attribute.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: download
HTML Attribute: download
Description: Tells the browser to download the linked file as this filename. Only used when `href` is present.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: form
HTML Attribute: form
Description: The "form owner" to associate the button with. If omitted, the closest containing form will be used instead. The
value of this attribute must be an id of a form in the same document or shadow root as the button.
Expected Type: string | null
Default Property Value: null
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: formAction
HTML Attribute: formaction
Description: Used to override the form owner's `action` attribute.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: formEnctype
HTML Attribute: formenctype
Description: Used to override the form owner's `enctype` attribute.
Expected Type: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' | 'multipart/form-data' | 'text/plain'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: formMethod
HTML Attribute: formmethod
Description: Used to override the form owner's `method` attribute.
Expected Type: 'post' | 'get'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: formNoValidate
HTML Attribute: formnovalidate
Description: Used to override the form owner's `novalidate` attribute.
Expected Type: boolean
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: formTarget
HTML Attribute: formtarget
Description: Used to override the form owner's `target` attribute.
Expected Type: '_self' | '_blank' | '_parent' | '_top' | string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: blur
Event Description: Emitted when the button loses focus.

Event Name: focus
Event Description: Emitted when the button gains focus.

Event Name: wa-invalid
Event Description: Emitted when the form control has been checked for validity and its constraints aren't satisfied.

#### CSS Custom Properties





#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-button>`

`<wa-icon>`
`<wa-spinner>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-button>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/button/button.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/button/button.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaButton from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/button/index.js';`

Default Property Value: false

JS Property: withMedia

Description: Renders the card with an image. Only needed for SSR, otherwise is automatically added.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: withFooter
HTML Attribute: with-footer
Description: Renders the card with a footer. Only needed for SSR, otherwise is automatically added.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Events

## Component documentation for: Carousel

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-carousel>`

Available since version: 2.2

Component Status: experimental

Summary: Carousels display an arbitrary number of content slides along a horizontal or vertical axis.

### API Documentation for `<wa-carousel>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The carousel's main content, one or more `<wa-carousel-item>` elements.

Slot Name: next-icon
Slot Description: Optional next icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

Slot Name: previous-icon
Slot Description: Optional previous icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: loop
HTML Attribute: loop
Description: When set, allows the user to navigate the carousel in the same direction indefinitely.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: navigation
HTML Attribute: navigation
Description: When set, show the carousel's navigation.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: pagination
HTML Attribute: pagination
Description: When set, show the carousel's pagination indicators.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: autoplay
HTML Attribute: autoplay
Description: When set, the slides will scroll automatically when the user is not interacting with them.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: autoplayInterval
HTML Attribute: autoplay-interval
Description: Specifies the amount of time, in milliseconds, between each automatic scroll.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 3000
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: slidesPerPage
HTML Attribute: slides-per-page
Description: Specifies how many slides should be shown at a given time.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: slidesPerMove
HTML Attribute: slides-per-move
Description: Specifies the number of slides the carousel will advance when scrolling, useful when specifying a `slides-per-page`
greater than one. It can't be higher than `slides-per-page`.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: orientation

## Component documentation for: Color Picker

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-color-picker>`

### API Documentation for `<wa-color-picker>`

#### Slot Documentation

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: value
Description: The current value of the color picker. The value's format will vary based the `format` attribute. To get the value

data.
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: defaultValue
HTML Attribute: value
Description: The default value of the form control. Primarily used for resetting the form control.
Expected Type: string | null
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

display HTML, you can use the `label` slot` instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: hint
HTML Attribute: hint
Description: The color picker's hint. If you need to display HTML, use the `hint` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: format
HTML Attribute: format
Description: The format to use. If opacity is enabled, these will translate to HEXA, RGBA, HSLA, and HSVA respectively. The color
picker will accept user input in any format (including CSS color names) and convert it to the desired format.
Expected Type: 'hex' | 'rgb' | 'hsl' | 'hsv'
Default Property Value: 'hex'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: size
HTML Attribute: size
Description: Determines the size of the color picker's trigger
Expected Type: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
Default Property Value: 'medium'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: withoutFormatToggle

Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: opacity
HTML Attribute: opacity
Description: Shows the opacity slider. Enabling this will cause the formatted value to be HEXA, RGBA, or HSLA.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: uppercase
HTML Attribute: uppercase
Description: By default, values are lowercase. With this attribute, values will be uppercase instead.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: swatches
HTML Attribute: swatches
Description: One or more predefined color swatches to display as presets in the color picker. Can include any format the color
picker can parse, including HEX(A), RGB(A), HSL(A), HSV(A), and CSS color names. Each color must be separated by a
semicolon (`;`). Alternatively, you can pass an array of color values to this property using JavaScript.
Expected Type: string | string[]
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

HTML Attribute: form

Expected Type: null
Default Property Value: null

present, this value will take precedence. By default, the target element's `textContent` will be copied. To copy an
attribute, append the attribute name wrapped in square brackets, e.g. `from="el[value]"`. To copy a property,
append a dot and the property name, e.g. `from="el.value"`.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

Description: Disables the copy button.

Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

Description: A custom label to show in the tooltip when a copy error occurs.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1000
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

## Component documentation for: Dialog

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-dialog>`

Component Status: stable

Summary: Dialogs, sometimes called "modals", appear above the page and require the user's immediate attention.

### API Documentation for `<wa-dialog>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The dialog's main content.

Slot Name: label
Slot Description: The dialog's label. Alternatively, you can use the `label` attribute.

Slot Name: header-actions
Slot Description: Optional actions to add to the header. Works best with `<wa-button>`.

Slot Name: footer
Slot Description: The dialog's footer, usually one or more buttons representing various options.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: open
HTML Attribute: open
Description: Indicates whether or not the dialog is open. Toggle this attribute to show and hide the dialog.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: The dialog's label as displayed in the header. You should always include a relevant label, as it is required for
proper accessibility. If you need to display HTML, use the `label` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: withoutHeader
HTML Attribute: without-header
Description: Disables the header. This will also remove the default close button.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: lightDismiss
HTML Attribute: light-dismiss
Description: When enabled, the dialog will be closed when the user clicks outside of it.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-show
Event Description: Emitted when the dialog opens.

Event Name: wa-after-show
Event Description: Emitted after the dialog opens and all animations are complete.

Event Name: wa-hide
Event Description: Emitted when the dialog is requested to close. Calling `event.preventDefault()` will prevent the dialog from closing. You can inspect `event.detail.source` to see which element caused the dialog to close. If the source is the dialog element itself, the user has pressed [[Escape]] or the dialog has been closed programmatically. Avoid using this unless closing the dialog will result in destructive behavior such as data loss.

Event Name: wa-after-hide
Event Description: Emitted after the dialog closes and all animations are complete.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--spacing)
CSS Property Description The amount of space around and between the dialog's content.

CSS Property: var(--width)
CSS Property Description The preferred width of the dialog. Note that the dialog will shrink to accommodate smaller screens.

CSS Property: var(--show-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when showing the dialog.
Default Value: 200ms

CSS Property: var(--hide-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when hiding the dialog.
Default Value: 200ms

#### CSS Parts

To temporarily disable focus trapping and allow third-party modals spawned from an active Shoelace modal, call `modal.activateExternal()` when the third-party modal opens. Upon closing, call `modal.deactivateExternal()` to restore Shoelace's focus trapping.

Event Description: Emitted after the drawer opens and all animations are complete.

Event Name: wa-hide
Event Description: Emitted when the drawer is requesting to close. Calling `event.preventDefault()` will prevent the drawer from closing. You can inspect `event.detail.source` to see which element caused the drawer to close. If the source is the drawer element itself, the user has pressed [[Escape]] or the drawer has been closed programmatically. Avoid using this unless closing the drawer will result in destructive behavior such as data loss.

Event Name: wa-after-hide
Event Description: Emitted after the drawer closes and all animations are complete.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--spacing)
CSS Property Description The amount of space around and between the drawer's content.

CSS Property: var(--size)
CSS Property Description The preferred size of the drawer. This will be applied to the drawer's width or height depending on its `placement`. Note that the drawer will shrink to accommodate smaller screens.

CSS Property: var(--show-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when showing the drawer.
Default Value: 200ms

CSS Property: var(--hide-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when hiding the drawer.
Default Value: 200ms

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-drawer>`

`<wa-button>`
`<wa-icon>`
`<wa-spinner>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-drawer>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/drawer/drawer.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/drawer/drawer.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaDrawer from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/drawer/index.js';`

    | 'top-start'
    | 'top-end'
    | 'bottom'
    | 'bottom-start'
    | 'bottom-end'

    | 'left-end'

## Component documentation for: Icon

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-icon>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Icons are symbols that can be used to represent various options within an application.

### API Documentation for `<wa-icon>`

#### Slot Documentation





#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: name
HTML Attribute: name
Description: The name of the icon to draw. Available names depend on the icon library being used.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: family
HTML Attribute: family
Description: The family of icons to choose from. For Font Awesome Free, valid options include `classic` and `brands`. For
Font Awesome Pro subscribers, valid options include, `classic`, `sharp`, `duotone`, `sharp-duotone`, and `brands`.
A valid kit code must be present to show pro icons via CDN. You can set `<html data-fa-kit-code="...">` to provide
one.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: variant
HTML Attribute: variant
Description: The name of the icon's variant. For Font Awesome, valid options include `thin`, `light`, `regular`, and `solid` for
the `classic` and `sharp` families. Some variants require a Font Awesome Pro subscription. Custom icon libraries
may or may not use this property.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: fixedWidth
HTML Attribute: fixed-width
Description: Draws the icon in a fixed-width both.
Expected Type: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: src
HTML Attribute: src
Description: An external URL of an SVG file. Be sure you trust the content you are including, as it will be executed as code and
can result in XSS attacks.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: An alternate description to use for assistive devices. If omitted, the icon will be considered presentational and
ignored by assistive devices.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: library
HTML Attribute: library
Description: The name of a registered custom icon library.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: 'default'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-load
Event Description: Emitted when the icon has loaded. When using `spriteSheet: true` this will not emit.

Event Name: wa-error
Event Description: Emitted when the icon fails to load due to an error. When using `spriteSheet: true` this will not emit.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property Description Sets a duotone icon's primary color.
Default Value: currentColor

CSS Property: var(--primary-opacity)
CSS Property Description Sets a duotone icon's primary opacity.
Default Value: 1

CSS Property: var(--secondary-color)
CSS Property Description Sets a duotone icon's secondary color.
Default Value: currentColor

CSS Property: var(--secondary-opacity)
CSS Property Description Sets a duotone icon's secondary opacity.

## Component documentation for: Input

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-input>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Inputs collect data from the user.

### API Documentation for `<wa-input>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: label
Slot Description: The input's label. Alternatively, you can use the `label` attribute.

Slot Name: start
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed at the start of the input control.

Slot Name: end
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed at the end of the input control.

Slot Name: clear-icon
Slot Description: An icon to use in lieu of the default clear icon.

Slot Name: show-password-icon
Slot Description: An icon to use in lieu of the default show password icon.

Slot Name: hide-password-icon
Slot Description: An icon to use in lieu of the default hide password icon.

Slot Name: hint
Slot Description: Text that describes how to use the input. Alternatively, you can use the `hint` attribute.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: type
HTML Attribute: type
Description: The type of input. Works the same as a native `<input>` element, but only a subset of types are supported. Defaults
to `text`.
Expected Type:  'date'
    | 'datetime-local'
    | 'email'
    | 'number'
    | 'password'
    | 'search'
    | 'tel'
    | 'text'
    | 'time'
    | 'url'
Default Property Value: 'text'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: value
Description: The current value of the input, submitted as a name/value pair with form data.
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: defaultValue
HTML Attribute: value
Description: The default value of the form control. Primarily used for resetting the form control.
Expected Type: string | null
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: size
HTML Attribute: size
Description: The input's size.
Expected Type: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
Default Property Value: 'medium'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: appearance
HTML Attribute: appearance
Description: The input's visual appearance.
Expected Type: 'filled' | 'outlined'
Default Property Value: 'outlined'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: pill
HTML Attribute: pill
Description: Draws a pill-style input with rounded edges.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: The input's label. If you need to display HTML, use the `label` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: hint
HTML Attribute: hint
Description: The input's hint. If you need to display HTML, use the `hint` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withClear
HTML Attribute: with-clear
Description: Adds a clear button when the input is not empty.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: placeholder
HTML Attribute: placeholder
Description: Placeholder text to show as a hint when the input is empty.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: readonly
HTML Attribute: readonly
Description: Makes the input readonly.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: passwordToggle
HTML Attribute: password-toggle
Description: Adds a button to toggle the password's visibility. Only applies to password types.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: passwordVisible
HTML Attribute: password-visible
Description: Determines whether or not the password is currently visible. Only applies to password input types.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withoutSpinButtons
HTML Attribute: without-spin-buttons
Description: Hides the browser's built-in increment/decrement spin buttons for number inputs.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: form
HTML Attribute: form
Description: By default, form controls are associated with the nearest containing `<form>` element. This attribute allows you
to place the form control outside of a form and associate it with the form that has this `id`. The form must be in
the same document or shadow root for this to work.
Expected Type: null
Default Property Value: null
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: required
HTML Attribute: required
Description: Makes the input a required field.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: pattern
HTML Attribute: pattern
Description: A regular expression pattern to validate input against.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: minlength
HTML Attribute: minlength
Description: The minimum length of input that will be considered valid.
Expected Type: number
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: maxlength
HTML Attribute: maxlength
Description: The maximum length of input that will be considered valid.
Expected Type: number
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: min
HTML Attribute: min
Description: The input's minimum value. Only applies to date and number input types.
Expected Type: number | string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: max
HTML Attribute: max
Description: The input's maximum value. Only applies to date and number input types.
Expected Type: number | string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: step
HTML Attribute: step
Description: Specifies the granularity that the value must adhere to, or the special value `any` which means no stepping is
implied, allowing any numeric value. Only applies to date and number input types.
Expected Type: number | 'any'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autocapitalize
HTML Attribute: autocapitalize
Description: Controls whether and how text input is automatically capitalized as it is entered by the user.
Expected Type: 'off' | 'none' | 'on' | 'sentences' | 'words' | 'characters'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autocorrect
HTML Attribute: autocorrect
Description: Indicates whether the browser's autocorrect feature is on or off.
Expected Type: 'off' | 'on'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autocomplete
HTML Attribute: autocomplete
Description: Specifies what permission the browser has to provide assistance in filling out form field values. Refer to
[this page on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete) for available values.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autofocus
HTML Attribute: autofocus
Description: Indicates that the input should receive focus on page load.
Expected Type: boolean
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: enterkeyhint
HTML Attribute: enterkeyhint
Description: Used to customize the label or icon of the Enter key on virtual keyboards.
Expected Type: 'enter' | 'done' | 'go' | 'next' | 'previous' | 'search' | 'send'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: spellcheck
HTML Attribute: spellcheck
Description: Enables spell checking on the input.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: true
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: inputmode
HTML Attribute: inputmode
Description: Tells the browser what type of data will be entered by the user, allowing it to display the appropriate virtual
keyboard on supportive devices.
Expected Type: 'none' | 'text' | 'decimal' | 'numeric' | 'tel' | 'search' | 'email' | 'url'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withLabel
HTML Attribute: with-label
Description: Used for SSR. Will determine if the SSRed component will have the label slot rendered on initial paint.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withHint
HTML Attribute: with-hint
Description: Used for SSR. Will determine if the SSRed component will have the hint slot rendered on initial paint.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: input
Event Description: Emitted when the control receives input.

Event Name: change
Event Description: Emitted when an alteration to the control's value is committed by the user.

Event Name: blur
Event Description: Emitted when the control loses focus.

Event Name: focus
Event Description: Emitted when the control gains focus.

Event Name: wa-clear
Event Description: Emitted when the clear button is activated.

Event Name: wa-invalid
Event Description: Emitted when the form control has been checked for validity and its constraints aren't satisfied.

#### CSS Custom Properties





#### CSS Custom States

State name: blank
State description: The input is empty.
State CSS selector: `:state(blank)`

HTML Attribute: value
Description: The option's value. When selected, the containing form control will receive this value. The value must be unique
from other options in the same group. Values may not contain spaces, as spaces are used as delimiters when listing
multiple values.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

HTML Attribute: selected
Description: Selects an option initially.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: The option’s plain text label.
Usually automatically generated, but can be useful to provide manually for cases involving complex content.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: defaultLabel
Description: The default label, generated from the element contents. Will be equal to `label` in most cases.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

## Component documentation for: Page

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-page>`

Available since version: 3.0

Component Status: experimental

Summary: Pages offer an easy way to scaffold entire page layouts using minimal markup.

### API Documentation for `<wa-page>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The page's main content.

Slot Name: banner
Slot Description: The banner that gets display above the header. The banner will not be shown if no content is provided.

Slot Name: header
Slot Description: The header to display at the top of the page. If a banner is present, the header will appear below the banner. The header will not be shown if there is no content.

Slot Name: subheader
Slot Description: A subheader to display below the `header`. This is a good place to put things like breadcrumbs.

Slot Name: menu
Slot Description: The left side of the page. If you slot an element in here, you will override the default `navigation` slot and will be handling navigation on your own. This also will not disable the fallback behavior of the navigation button. This section "sticks" to the top as the page scrolls.

Slot Name: navigation-header
Slot Description: The header for a navigation area. On mobile this will be the header for `<wa-drawer>`.

Slot Name: navigation
Slot Description: The main content to display in the navigation area. This is displayed on the left side of the page, if `menu` is not used. This section "sticks" to the top as the page scrolls.

Slot Name: navigation-footer
Slot Description: The footer for a navigation area. On mobile this will be the footer for `<wa-drawer>`.

Slot Name: navigation-toggle
Slot Description: Use this slot to slot in your own button + icon for toggling the navigation drawer. By default it is a `<wa-button>` + a 3 bars `<wa-icon>`

Slot Name: navigation-toggle-icon
Slot Description: Use this to slot in your own icon for toggling the navigation drawer. By default it is 3 bars `<wa-icon>`.

Slot Name: main-header
Slot Description: Header to display inline above the main content.

Slot Name: main-footer
Slot Description: Footer to display inline below the main content.

Slot Name: aside
Slot Description: Content to be shown on the right side of the page. Typically contains a table of contents, ads, etc. This section "sticks" to the top as the page scrolls.

Slot Name: skip-to-content
Slot Description: The "skip to content" slot. You can override this If you would like to override the `Skip to content` button and add additional "Skip to X", they can be inserted here.

Slot Name: footer
Slot Description: The content to display in the footer. This is always displayed underneath the viewport so will always make the page "scrollable".

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: view
HTML Attribute: view
Description: The view is a reflection of the "mobileBreakpoint", when the page is larger than the `mobile-breakpoint` (768px by
default), it is considered to be a "desktop" view. The view is merely a way to distinguish when to show/hide the
navigation. You can use additional media queries to make other adjustments to content as necessary.
The default is "desktop" because the "mobile navigation drawer" isn't accessible via SSR due to drawer requiring JS.
Expected Type: 'mobile' | 'desktop'
Default Property Value: 'desktop'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: navOpen
HTML Attribute: nav-open
Description: Whether or not the navigation drawer is open. Note, the navigation drawer is only "open" on mobile views.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: mobileBreakpoint
HTML Attribute: mobile-breakpoint
Description: At what page width to hide the "navigation" slot and collapse into a hamburger button.
Accepts both numbers (interpreted as px) and CSS lengths (e.g. `50em`), which are resolved based on the root element.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: '768px'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: navigationPlacement
HTML Attribute: navigation-placement
Description: Where to place the navigation when in the mobile viewport.
Expected Type: 'start' | 'end'
Default Property Value: 'start'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: disableNavigationToggle
HTML Attribute: disable-navigation-toggle
Description: Determines whether or not to hide the default hamburger button.
This will automatically flip to "true" if you add an element with `data-toggle-nav` anywhere in the element light DOM.
Generally this will be set for you and you don't need to do anything, unless you're using SSR, in which case you should set this manually for initial page loads.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Methods on the element



#### Events





#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--menu-width)
CSS Property Description The width of the page's "menu" section.
Default Value: auto

CSS Property: var(--main-width)
CSS Property Description The width of the page's "main" section.
Default Value: 1fr

CSS Property: var(--aside-width)
CSS Property Description The wide of the page's "aside" section.
Default Value: auto

CSS Property: var(--banner-height)
CSS Property Description The height of the banner. This gets calculated when the page initializes. If the height is known, you can set it here to prevent shifting when the page loads.
Default Value: 0px

CSS Property: var(--header-height)
CSS Property Description The height of the header. This gets calculated when the page initializes. If the height is known, you can set it here to prevent shifting when the page loads.
Default Value: 0px

CSS Property: var(--subheader-height)
CSS Property Description The height of the subheader. This gets calculated when the page initializes. If the height is known, you can set it here to prevent shifting when the page loads.
Default Value: 0px

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-page>`



#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-page>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/page/page.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/page/page.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaPage from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/page/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Popover

### API Documentation for `<wa-popover>`

HTML Attribute: placement
Description: The preferred placement of the popover. Note that the actual placement may vary as needed to keep the popover
inside of the viewport.
Expected Type:  'top'
    | 'top-start'
    | 'top-end'
    | 'right'
    | 'right-start'
    | 'right-end'
    | 'bottom'
    | 'bottom-start'
    | 'bottom-end'
    | 'left'
    | 'left-start'
    | 'left-end'

HTML Attribute: open
Description: Shows or hides the popover.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: distance
HTML Attribute: distance
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the popover away from its target.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 8
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: skidding
HTML Attribute: skidding
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the popover along its target.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

HTML Attribute: for
Description: The ID of the popover's anchor element. This must be an interactive/focusable element such as a button.
Expected Type: string | null
Default Property Value: null
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withoutArrow
HTML Attribute: without-arrow
Description: Removes the arrow from the popover.

Event Name: wa-after-show

Event Name: wa-hide
Event Description: Emitted when the popover begins to hide. Canceling this event will stop the popover from hiding.

Event Name: wa-after-hide
Event Description: Emitted after the popover has hidden and all animations are complete.

Default Value: 25rem

CSS Property: var(--show-duration)
CSS Property Description The speed of the show animation.
Default Value: 100ms

CSS Property: var(--hide-duration)
CSS Property Description The speed of the hide animation.
Default Value: 100ms

## Component documentation for: Popup

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-popup>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Popup is a utility that lets you declaratively anchor "popup" containers to another element.

### API Documentation for `<wa-popup>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The popup's content.

Slot Name: anchor
Slot Description: The element the popup will be anchored to. If the anchor lives outside of the popup, you can use the `anchor` attribute or property instead.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: popup
Description: A reference to the internal popup container. Useful for animating and styling the popup with JavaScript.
Expected Type: HTMLElement
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: anchor
HTML Attribute: anchor
Description: The element the popup will be anchored to. If the anchor lives outside of the popup, you can provide the anchor
element `id`, a DOM element reference, or a `VirtualElement`. If the anchor lives inside the popup, use the
`anchor` slot instead.
Expected Type: Element | string | VirtualElement
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: active
HTML Attribute: active
Description: Activates the positioning logic and shows the popup. When this attribute is removed, the positioning logic is torn
down and the popup will be hidden.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: placement
HTML Attribute: placement
Description: The preferred placement of the popup. Note that the actual placement will vary as configured to keep the
panel inside of the viewport.
Expected Type:  'top'
    | 'top-start'
    | 'top-end'
    | 'bottom'
    | 'bottom-start'
    | 'bottom-end'
    | 'right'
    | 'right-start'
    | 'right-end'
    | 'left'
    | 'left-start'
    | 'left-end'
Default Property Value: 'top'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: boundary
HTML Attribute: boundary
Description: The bounding box to use for flipping, shifting, and auto-sizing.
Expected Type: 'viewport' | 'scroll'
Default Property Value: 'viewport'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: distance
HTML Attribute: distance
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the panel away from its anchor.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: skidding
HTML Attribute: skidding
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the panel along its anchor.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: arrow
HTML Attribute: arrow
Description: Attaches an arrow to the popup. The arrow's size and color can be customized using the `--arrow-size` and
`--arrow-color` custom properties. For additional customizations, you can also target the arrow using
`::part(arrow)` in your stylesheet.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: arrowPlacement
HTML Attribute: arrow-placement
Description: The placement of the arrow. The default is `anchor`, which will align the arrow as close to the center of the
anchor as possible, considering available space and `arrow-padding`. A value of `start`, `end`, or `center` will
align the arrow to the start, end, or center of the popover instead.
Expected Type: 'start' | 'end' | 'center' | 'anchor'
Default Property Value: 'anchor'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: arrowPadding
HTML Attribute: arrow-padding
Description: The amount of padding between the arrow and the edges of the popup. If the popup has a border-radius, for example,
this will prevent it from overflowing the corners.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 10
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: flip
HTML Attribute: flip
Description: When set, placement of the popup will flip to the opposite site to keep it in view. You can use
`flipFallbackPlacements` to further configure how the fallback placement is determined.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: flipFallbackPlacements
HTML Attribute: flip-fallback-placements
Description: If the preferred placement doesn't fit, popup will be tested in these fallback placements until one fits. Must be a
string of any number of placements separated by a space, e.g. "top bottom left". If no placement fits, the flip
fallback strategy will be used instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: flipFallbackStrategy
HTML Attribute: flip-fallback-strategy
Description: When neither the preferred placement nor the fallback placements fit, this value will be used to determine whether
the popup should be positioned using the best available fit based on available space or as it was initially
preferred.
Expected Type: 'best-fit' | 'initial'
Default Property Value: 'best-fit'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: flipBoundary
HTML Attribute: flipBoundary
Description: The flip boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when flipping. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.
Expected Type: Element | Element[]
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: flipPadding
HTML Attribute: flip-padding
Description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the flip behavior will occur.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: shift
HTML Attribute: shift
Description: Moves the popup along the axis to keep it in view when clipped.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: shiftBoundary
HTML Attribute: shiftBoundary
Description: The shift boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when shifting. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.
Expected Type: Element | Element[]
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: shiftPadding
HTML Attribute: shift-padding
Description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the shift behavior will occur.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autoSize
HTML Attribute: auto-size
Description: When set, this will cause the popup to automatically resize itself to prevent it from overflowing.
Expected Type: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: sync
HTML Attribute: sync
Description: Syncs the popup's width or height to that of the anchor element.
Expected Type: 'width' | 'height' | 'both'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autoSizeBoundary
HTML Attribute: autoSizeBoundary
Description: The auto-size boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when resizing. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.
Expected Type: Element | Element[]
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: autoSizePadding
HTML Attribute: auto-size-padding
Description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the auto-size behavior will occur.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: hoverBridge
HTML Attribute: hover-bridge
Description: When a gap exists between the anchor and the popup element, this option will add a "hover bridge" that fills the
gap using an invisible element. This makes listening for events such as `mouseenter` and `mouseleave` more sane
because the pointer never technically leaves the element. The hover bridge will only be drawn when the popover is
active.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-reposition
Event Description: Emitted when the popup is repositioned. This event can fire a lot, so avoid putting expensive operations in your listener or consider debouncing it.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--arrow-size)
CSS Property Description The size of the arrow. Note that an arrow won't be shown unless the `arrow` attribute is used.
Default Value: 6px

CSS Property: var(--arrow-color)
CSS Property Description The color of the arrow.
Default Value: black

CSS Property: var(--auto-size-available-width)
CSS Property Description A read-only custom property that determines the amount of width the popup can be before overflowing. Useful for positioning child elements that need to overflow. This property is only available when using `auto-size`.

CSS Property: var(--auto-size-available-height)
CSS Property Description A read-only custom property that determines the amount of height the popup can be before overflowing. Useful for positioning child elements that need to overflow. This property is only available when using `auto-size`.

CSS Property: var(--show-duration)
CSS Property Description The show duration to use when applying built-in animation classes.
Default Value: 100ms

CSS Property: var(--hide-duration)
CSS Property Description The hide duration to use when applying built-in animation classes.
Default Value: 100ms

#### CSS Parts

Default Property Value: false

Description: Used for SSR. if true, will show slotted label on initial render.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withHint
HTML Attribute: with-hint
Description: Used for SSR. if true, will show slotted hint on initial render.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: validationTarget
Description: We use the first available radio as the validationTarget similar to native HTML that shows the validation popup on

## Component documentation for: Select

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-select>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Selects allow you to choose items from a menu of predefined options.

### API Documentation for `<wa-select>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The listbox options. Must be `<wa-option>` elements. You can use `<wa-divider>` to group items visually.

Slot Name: label
Slot Description: The input's label. Alternatively, you can use the `label` attribute.

Slot Name: start
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed at the start of the combobox.

Slot Name: end
Slot Description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed at the end of the combobox.

Slot Name: clear-icon
Slot Description: An icon to use in lieu of the default clear icon.

Slot Name: expand-icon
Slot Description: The icon to show when the control is expanded and collapsed. Rotates on open and close.

Slot Name: hint
Slot Description: Text that describes how to use the input. Alternatively, you can use the `hint` attribute.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: validationTarget
Description: Where to anchor native constraint validation
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: name
HTML Attribute: name
Description: The name of the select, submitted as a name/value pair with form data.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: value
HTML Attribute: value
Description: The select's value. This will be a string for single select or an array for multi-select.
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: size
HTML Attribute: size
Description: The select's size.
Expected Type: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
Default Property Value: 'medium'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: placeholder
HTML Attribute: placeholder
Description: Placeholder text to show as a hint when the select is empty.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: multiple
HTML Attribute: multiple
Description: Allows more than one option to be selected.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: maxOptionsVisible
HTML Attribute: max-options-visible
Description: The maximum number of selected options to show when `multiple` is true. After the maximum, "+n" will be shown to
indicate the number of additional items that are selected. Set to 0 to remove the limit.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 3
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: disabled
HTML Attribute: disabled
Description: Disables the select control.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withClear
HTML Attribute: with-clear
Description: Adds a clear button when the select is not empty.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: open
HTML Attribute: open
Description: Indicates whether or not the select is open. You can toggle this attribute to show and hide the menu, or you can
use the `show()` and `hide()` methods and this attribute will reflect the select's open state.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: appearance
HTML Attribute: appearance
Description: The select's visual appearance.
Expected Type: 'filled' | 'outlined'
Default Property Value: 'outlined'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: pill
HTML Attribute: pill
Description: Draws a pill-style select with rounded edges.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: label
HTML Attribute: label
Description: The select's label. If you need to display HTML, use the `label` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: placement
HTML Attribute: placement
Description: The preferred placement of the select's menu. Note that the actual placement may vary as needed to keep the listbox
inside of the viewport.
Expected Type: 'top' | 'bottom'
Default Property Value: 'bottom'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: hint
HTML Attribute: hint
Description: The select's hint. If you need to display HTML, use the `hint` slot instead.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: ''
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withLabel
HTML Attribute: with-label
Description: Used for SSR purposes when a label is slotted in. Will show the label on first render.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withHint
HTML Attribute: with-hint
Description: Used for SSR purposes when hint is slotted in. Will show the hint on first render.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: form
HTML Attribute: form
Description: By default, form controls are associated with the nearest containing `<form>` element. This attribute allows you
to place the form control outside of a form and associate it with the form that has this `id`. The form must be in
the same document or shadow root for this to work.
Expected Type: null
Default Property Value: null
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: required
HTML Attribute: required
Description: The select's required attribute.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: getTag
Description: A function that customizes the tags to be rendered when multiple=true. The first argument is the option, the second
is the current tag's index.  The function should return either a Lit TemplateResult or a string containing trusted
HTML of the symbol to render at the specified value.
Expected Type: (option: WaOption, index: number) => TemplateResult | string | HTMLElement
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

Event Description: Emitted when the select's menu closes.

Event Description: Emitted when the control receives input.

State description: Applied when the slider is being dragged.
State CSS selector: `:state(dragging)`

State name: focused
State description: Applied when the slider has focus.
State CSS selector: `:state(focused)`

State name: user-valid
State description: Applied when the slider is valid and the user has sufficiently interacted with it.
State CSS selector: `:state(user-valid)`

State name: user-invalid
State description: Applied when the slider is invalid and the user has sufficiently interacted with it.
State CSS selector: `:state(user-invalid)`

## Component documentation for: Split Panel

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-split-panel>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Split panels display two adjacent panels, allowing the user to reposition them.

### API Documentation for `<wa-split-panel>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: start
Slot Description: Content to place in the start panel.

Slot Name: end
Slot Description: Content to place in the end panel.

Slot Name: divider
Slot Description: The divider. Useful for slotting in a custom icon that renders as a handle.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: position
HTML Attribute: position
Description: The current position of the divider from the primary panel's edge as a percentage 0-100. Defaults to 50% of the
container's initial size.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 50
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: positionInPixels
HTML Attribute: position-in-pixels
Description: The current position of the divider from the primary panel's edge in pixels.
Expected Type: number
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: orientation
HTML Attribute: orientation
Description: Sets the split panel's orientation.
Expected Type: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
Default Property Value: 'horizontal'
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: disabled
HTML Attribute: disabled
Description: Disables resizing. Note that the position may still change as a result of resizing the host element.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: primary
HTML Attribute: primary
Description: If no primary panel is designated, both panels will resize proportionally when the host element is resized. If a
primary panel is designated, it will maintain its size and the other panel will grow or shrink as needed when the
host element is resized.
Expected Type: 'start' | 'end' | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: snap
HTML Attribute: snap
Description: One or more space-separated values at which the divider should snap. Values can be in pixels or percentages, e.g.
`"100px 50%"`.
Expected Type: string | undefined
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: snapThreshold
HTML Attribute: snap-threshold
Description: How close the divider must be to a snap point until snapping occurs.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 12
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-reposition
Event Description: Emitted when the divider's position changes.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--divider-width)
CSS Property Description The width of the visible divider.
Default Value: 4px

CSS Property: var(--divider-hit-area)
CSS Property Description The invisible region around the divider where dragging can occur. This is usually wider than the divider to facilitate easier dragging.
Default Value: 12px

CSS Property: var(--min)
CSS Property Description The minimum allowed size of the primary panel.
Default Value: 0

CSS Property: var(--max)
CSS Property Description The maximum allowed size of the primary panel.
Default Value: 100%

## Component documentation for: Tooltip

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-tooltip>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Tooltips display additional information based on a specific action.

### API Documentation for `<wa-tooltip>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The tooltip's default slot where any content should live. Interactive content should be avoided.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: placement
HTML Attribute: placement
Description: The preferred placement of the tooltip. Note that the actual placement may vary as needed to keep the tooltip
inside of the viewport.
Expected Type:  'top'
    | 'top-start'
    | 'top-end'
    | 'right'
    | 'right-start'
    | 'right-end'
    | 'bottom'
    | 'bottom-start'
    | 'bottom-end'
    | 'left'
    | 'left-start'
    | 'left-end'
Default Property Value: 'top'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: disabled
HTML Attribute: disabled
Description: Disables the tooltip so it won't show when triggered.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: distance
HTML Attribute: distance
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the tooltip away from its target.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 8
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: open
HTML Attribute: open
Description: Indicates whether or not the tooltip is open. You can use this in lieu of the show/hide methods.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: skidding
HTML Attribute: skidding
Description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the tooltip along its target.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: showDelay
HTML Attribute: show-delay
Description: The amount of time to wait before showing the tooltip when the user mouses in.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 150
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: hideDelay
HTML Attribute: hide-delay
Description: The amount of time to wait before hiding the tooltip when the user mouses out..
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 0
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: trigger
HTML Attribute: trigger
Description: Controls how the tooltip is activated. Possible options include `click`, `hover`, `focus`, and `manual`. Multiple
options can be passed by separating them with a space. When manual is used, the tooltip must be activated
programmatically.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: 'hover focus'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withoutArrow
HTML Attribute: without-arrow
Description: Removes the arrow from the tooltip.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-show
Event Description: Emitted when the tooltip begins to show.

Event Name: wa-after-show
Event Description: Emitted after the tooltip has shown and all animations are complete.

Event Name: wa-hide
Event Description: Emitted when the tooltip begins to hide.

Event Name: wa-after-hide
Event Description: Emitted after the tooltip has hidden and all animations are complete.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--max-width)
CSS Property Description The maximum width of the tooltip before its content will wrap.

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-tooltip>`

`<wa-popup>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-tooltip>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/tooltip/tooltip.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/tooltip/tooltip.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaTooltip from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/tooltip/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Tree

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-tree>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Trees allow you to display a hierarchical list of selectable [tree items](/docs/components/tree-item). Items with children can be expanded and collapsed as desired by the user.

### API Documentation for `<wa-tree>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The default slot.

Slot Name: expand-icon
Slot Description: The icon to show when the tree item is expanded. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

Slot Name: collapse-icon
Slot Description: The icon to show when the tree item is collapsed. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: selection
HTML Attribute: selection
Description: The selection behavior of the tree. Single selection allows only one node to be selected at a time. Multiple
displays checkboxes and allows more than one node to be selected. Leaf allows only leaf nodes to be selected.
Expected Type: 'single' | 'multiple' | 'leaf'
Default Property Value: 'single'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-selection-change
Event Description: Emitted when a tree item is selected or deselected.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--indent-size)
CSS Property Description The size of the indentation for nested items.
Default Value: var(--wa-spacing-m)

CSS Property: var(--indent-guide-color)
CSS Property Description The color of the indentation line.
Default Value: var(--wa-color-surface-border)

CSS Property: var(--indent-guide-offset)
CSS Property Description The amount of vertical spacing to leave between the top and bottom of the indentation line's starting position.
Default Value: 0

CSS Property: var(--indent-guide-style)
CSS Property Description The style of the indentation line, e.g. solid, dotted, dashed.
Default Value: solid

CSS Property: var(--indent-guide-width)
CSS Property Description The width of the indentation line.
Default Value: 0

#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-tree>`

`<wa-checkbox>`
`<wa-icon>`
`<wa-spinner>`
`<wa-tree-item>`
