`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/tree/tree.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/tree/tree.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaTree from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/tree/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Tree Item

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-tree-item>`

Available since version: 2.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: A tree item serves as a hierarchical node that lives inside a [tree](/docs/components/tree).

### API Documentation for `<wa-tree-item>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: (default)
Slot Description: The default slot.

Slot Name: expand-icon
Slot Description: The icon to show when the tree item is expanded.

Slot Name: collapse-icon
Slot Description: The icon to show when the tree item is collapsed.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: expanded
HTML Attribute: expanded
Description: Expands the tree item.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: selected
HTML Attribute: selected
Description: Draws the tree item in a selected state.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: disabled
HTML Attribute: disabled
Description: Disables the tree item.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: lazy
HTML Attribute: lazy
Description: Enables lazy loading behavior.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: wa-expand
Event Description: Emitted when the tree item expands.

Event Name: wa-after-expand
Event Description: Emitted after the tree item expands and all animations are complete.

Event Name: wa-collapse
Event Description: Emitted when the tree item collapses.

Event Name: wa-after-collapse
Event Description: Emitted after the tree item collapses and all animations are complete.

Event Name: wa-lazy-change
Event Description: Emitted when the tree item's lazy state changes.

Event Name: wa-lazy-load
Event Description: Emitted when a lazy item is selected. Use this event to asynchronously load data and append items to the tree before expanding. After appending new items, remove the `lazy` attribute to remove the loading state and update the tree.

#### CSS Custom Properties

CSS Property: var(--show-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when expanding tree items.
Default Value: 200ms

CSS Property: var(--hide-duration)
CSS Property Description The animation duration when collapsing tree items.
Default Value: 200ms

#### CSS Custom States

State name: disabled
State description: Applied when the tree item is disabled.
State CSS selector: `:state(disabled)`

State name: expanded
State description: Applied when the tree item is expanded.
State CSS selector: `:state(expanded)`

State name: indeterminate
State description: Applied when the selection is indeterminate.
State CSS selector: `:state(indeterminate)`

State name: selected
State description: Applied when the tree item is selected.
State CSS selector: `:state(selected)`

#### CSS Parts



#### Other Web Awesome components required by `<wa-tree-item>`

`<wa-checkbox>`
`<wa-icon>`
`<wa-spinner>`

#### Importing HTML Tag Name: `<wa-tree-item>` Web Component

##### CDN Import Path

`import 'https://early.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.0.0-beta.4/dist/components/tree-item/tree-item.js'`

##### NPM Import Path

`import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/tree-item/tree-item.js';`

##### React Import Path

`import WaTreeItem from '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/react/tree-item/index.js';`



## Component documentation for: Zoomable Frame

HTML Tag Name: `<wa-zoomable-frame>`

Available since version: 3.0

Component Status: stable

Summary: Zoomable frames render iframe content with zoom and interaction controls.

### API Documentation for `<wa-zoomable-frame>`

#### Slot Documentation

Slot Name: zoom-in-icon
Slot Description: The slot that contains the zoom in icon.

Slot Name: zoom-out-icon
Slot Description: The slot that contains the zoom out icon.

#### Properties and Attributes documentation

JS Property: src
HTML Attribute: src
Description: The URL of the content to display.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: srcdoc
HTML Attribute: srcdoc
Description: Inline HTML to display.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: allowfullscreen
HTML Attribute: allowfullscreen
Description: Allows fullscreen mode.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: loading
HTML Attribute: loading
Description: Controls iframe loading behavior.
Expected Type: 'eager' | 'lazy'
Default Property Value: 'eager'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: referrerpolicy
HTML Attribute: referrerpolicy
Description: Controls referrer information.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: sandbox
HTML Attribute: sandbox
Description: Security restrictions for the iframe.
Expected Type: string
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: zoom
HTML Attribute: zoom
Description: The current zoom of the frame, e.g. 0 = 0% and 1 = 100%.
Expected Type: number
Default Property Value: 1
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: zoomLevels
HTML Attribute: zoom-levels
Description: The zoom levels to step through when using zoom controls. This does not restrict programmatic changes to the zoom.
Expected Type: string
Default Property Value: '25% 50% 75% 100% 125% 150% 175% 200%'
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: withoutControls
HTML Attribute: without-controls
Description: Removes the zoom controls.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: withoutInteraction
HTML Attribute: without-interaction
Description: Disables interaction when present.
Expected Type: boolean
Default Property Value: false
Property Reflects to Attribute: true

JS Property: contentWindow
Description: Returns the internal iframe's `window` object. (Readonly property)
Expected Type: Window | null
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

JS Property: contentDocument
Description: Returns the internal iframe's `document` object. (Readonly property)
Expected Type: Document | null
Property Reflects to Attribute: false

#### Methods on the element



#### Events

Event Name: load
Event Description: Emitted when the internal iframe when it finishes loading.

Event Name: error
Event Description: Emitted from the internal iframe when it fails to load.

#### CSS Custom Properties





#### CSS Custom States



#### CSS Parts

##### NPM Import Path
